title: Add observability metrics/events for Dedicated autoscaling scaling decisions (bounds + predictive)
creator: Allison Grant
project: Autoscaling policies with customer bounds (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
description:
Context
Dedicated autoscaling is gaining strict min/max bounds and (optionally) predictive scaling. We need production-grade observability for: (1) correctness (no bound violations), (2) customer trust (“why did we scale?”), and (3) fleet health (oscillation, lag, stuck actuation).

This ticket adds metrics + structured events for scaling decisions. The intent is to power:
- SRE alerting/SLOs (bounds violations should be 0, scaling lag, oscillation)
- Internal debugging (which signal drove desired replicas)
- Customer-facing Console audit trail (ENG-2847 consumes the event stream)

Scope
1) Decision metrics (low-cardinality)
- Emit per-decision counters/gauges with constrained labels.
- Track desired replicas (pre/post clamp) and applied replicas (post actuation).
- Track clamp_reason and whether we were gated by forecast confidence.

2) Decision event (richer, sampled)
- Emit a structured scaling decision event containing the key inputs used by the controller, with strict redaction + cardinality control.
- Events are queryable for oncall debugging and for Console “Scaling History” rendering (via backend aggregation, not raw metric labels).

3) Scale latency + oscillation counters
- Time from decision -> actuation applied, plus error categories when actuation fails/stalls.
- Oscillation counters (direction changes within a window) and cooldown-related suppression counters.

Non-goals
- Building full dashboards/alerts here (owned in observability-pack; tracked by linked PR).
- Per-token cost attribution changes.

Implementation notes / guardrails
- Metrics must not label on pool_id/customer_id unboundedly. Use one of:
  - internal_pool_tier (e.g., dogfood/design-partner/ga)
  - region
  - hardware_class
  - controller_version
  - clamp_reason (finite enum)
- For debugging, rely on event logs stored in the decision-event store; keep events sampled (default 1:20) with a temporary per-pool override allowlist for incident response.

Proposed metrics (names may be adjusted to match Redwood conventions)
- dedicated_autoscaler_decision_total{region,hardware_class,controller_version,mode,source}++
  - mode: reactive|bounded|bounded_predictive
  - source: periodic|on_demand|manual
- dedicated_autoscaler_desired_replicas{region,hardware_class,controller_version,stage} gauge
  - stage: raw|clamped|applied
- dedicated_autoscaler_clamp_total{region,hardware_class,controller_version,clamp_reason}++
  - clamp_reason enum:
    - none
    - max_bound
    - min_bound
    - scale_rate_limit
    - cooldown_suppressed
    - capacity_shortage (fleet cannot provision)
    - drain_maintenance (min best-effort not achievable)
    - forecast_confidence_low (predictive ignored)
- dedicated_autoscaler_scale_latency_ms_bucket{region,hardware_class,controller_version,outcome} histogram
  - outcome: success|actuation_error|timeout|no_op
- dedicated_autoscaler_oscillation_total{region,hardware_class,controller_version,window}++
  - window: 5m|15m (fixed)
- dedicated_autoscaler_actuation_errors_total{region,hardware_class,controller_version,error_class}++
  - error_class: api_timeout|quota|scheduler_reject|unknown

Proposed decision event schema (for logs/events store; not as metric labels)
- timestamp
- pool_ref (stable internal identifier; for Console/ops only)
- controller_version
- region, hardware_class
- config snapshot (min,max,cooldown,scale_rate_limit)
- signal snapshot (queue_depth,gpu_util,p95_latency,throttle_rate,forecast_qps,forecast_confidence)
- desired (raw_desired, clamped_desired, applied)
- reasons (clamp_reason, primary_driver)

Primary_driver (finite enum)
- queue_depth
- latency
- utilization
- forecast
- min_bound
- max_bound
- cooldown
- scale_rate_limit

Acceptance criteria
- [x] Metrics emitted for every autoscaler evaluation tick with bounded label cardinality.
- [x] Structured decision event emitted with sampling and allowlist override.
- [x] Clamp reasons exposed consistently across autoscaler + policy engine outputs (same enum values).
- [x] Scale latency histogram records decision->applied timing; includes failure outcomes.
- [x] Oscillation counter increments on direction flips within window.
- [x] Docs snippet added to runbook: how to interpret clamp_reason/primary_driver and where to query events.
- [x] Dashboards/alerts PR references these metrics and passes review by SRE.

Links
- GitHub PR (autoscaler metrics + cardinality guardrails): sources/github/redwood/pr-21912.json
- GitHub PR (dashboards/alerts): sources/github/observability-pack/pr-842.json
- Related: ENG-2843 (bounds clamp), ENG-2845 (predictive blending), ENG-2847 (Console audit trail)

Rollout plan
- Ship metrics first behind existing autoscaler bounded feature flag (ENG-2848) to avoid breaking changes for legacy paths.
- Turn on decision events at 5% sampling globally; 100% sampling on dogfood pools; per-pool override via allowlist for incident response.

Testing
- Unit tests: metric label sets validated against allowlist; clamp_reason enum exhaustiveness.
- Integration: run autoscaler in staging with synthetic signals; verify desired->applied transitions produce expected metrics and scale latency.

Notes / open questions
- Do we want controller_version label on all metrics, or only on decision_total + clamp_total? (Trade-off: debugging vs TS churn; current plan: include it, but keep versions stable per weekly release.)
